column5: Download New Firmware thru OTA with CoreServer as the target device.
column6: Tag in paired condition with Star.
column7:
Initiate OTA from CoreServer/BLE 
1. Receive system update 
2. On next communication with Tag:
a. Query for current version information
b. If update required send New Image Announcement (NIA) message.
3. Handle DataReq messages, send image Data
4. Optional: Handle CRC requests, send CRC replies
5. Receive Apply Update Announcement. Dispatch to GUI for user notification.
6. On next communication with Tag query for Product Info, verify upgrade successful and update stored version info.
column8:
Tag Side:
1. Receive and process the NIA message
2. Write image info contained in NIA to Internal flash (image info block).
3. Erase/prepare Internal flash for storage (required pages).
4. Using info from image info block, get image from target by sending DataReq message.
5. Receive Data message and write to Internal MCU flash.
6. Verify data in flash against buffered data using CRC or byte-by-byte comparison.
7. Repeat steps c-e until entire image is downloaded and written to flash.
8. Verify full image CRC against CRC from NIA message (saved in image info block).
9. Write image status byte in image info block to indicate image successfully downloaded.
10. Send Apply Update Announcement.
11. Enter boot loader. (init and jump or reboot)
